title: Named source root stays unapplied: an acknowledged predecessor runtime-turn capture never reaches durable report readback or a terminal outcome
outcome: A named source root applies at the next opening once its predecessor captures have settled. A predecessor capture that cannot settle, for example because its report is lost or refused, reaches a terminal outcome within a bounded time and says why. A root session is never left with no supported way to confirm its binding.
acceptance: Diagnosis recorded with file:line (src/engram_unadmitted_focus.rs:341 and the observation worker): why acknowledged capture runtime-turn-67a8108a-4624-4d2a-be3f-5d45725ff347 (session-12325, Engram::Coder-MacosFixSol) stayed waiting for durable report readback from about 20:05Z to 21:54Z. Name its relationship to the Engram binary swaps at 20:23Z and 21:11Z on Central, and to w-5fe431225670.

A fix or a recovery path, with a behavioral test: a predecessor capture that cannot reach durable readback reaches a terminal outcome within a bounded time, with its cause stated, and the pending named root then applies. Capture ordering is not weakened.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
